data.name: StopHint
data.value: The safe way to take the controller down: the charger is returned to its pause current, the open charging session is closed and written, and the session store is flushed — none of which happens if the process is killed instead. It does not come back on its own; Restart below is the same shutdown, for a controller that should.

data.name: RestartHint
data.value: The same graceful shutdown as Stop, ending with the exit code that tells Docker or systemd to start it again. The new process reads its configuration afresh, which is how a change saved in Settings is applied.
